newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Nordbanken share drops on newspaper story.
newsitem.headline: Nordbanken share drops on newspaper story.

text.p: Shares in Swedish banking group Nordbanken plummeted on the Stockholm Stock Exchange on Thursday after a newspaper article said the Swedish government was likely to offer its 59 percent stake to investors.
At 1330 GMT, the share was down six crowns, or 2.7 percent, at 219 crowns, while the bank sector index was down 1.62 percent and the general index was 0.19 percent lower.
"Although interest rates are lower, (interest-sensitive) banking shares, including Nordbanken, are falling because of the newspaper article," an analyst said.

Banking shares have been riding on speculation about a restructuring of the banking sector since the autumn of 1996. Nordbanken has surged on speculation about a merger between the bank and rival S-E-Banken.
Indications that there might not be such a merger, made the share price fall, the analyst said.
